ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What is indicated by stage D?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a diagram of the frog life cycle, with arrows connecting each stage in order. On the left is adult frog A, at the top are eggs E, on the right there is tadpole stage B, at the bottom right is a tadpole that has grown hind legs, and the organism labeled D at the bottom left already has a frog-like body and limbs, but still retains an obvious tail. Reasoning: D is located after the tadpole stage and before the adult frog stage; in the frog life cycle, the stage in which legs have already grown but the tail has not yet completely disappeared is called froglet.
